definitions.explanation: A written document that provides instructions for operating something or carrying out a procedure.

definitions.gloss: manual (as opposed to automatic); manual transmission
definitions.explanation: Operated by hand rather than automatically. Often used for car transmissions.

examples.english: This factory has plans to replace manual work with robots.

notes:
From English "manual." In Japanese, sense 1 (handbook/guide) is the most common usage. Often shortened to マニュアル{通|どお}り (by the book) in workplace contexts, sometimes with a critical nuance implying inflexibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧マニュアル: operating manual
- ⟦{取扱説明書|とりあつかいせつめいしょ}→取扱説明書：10278_toriatsukaisetsumeisho⟧: instruction manual (formal equivalent)
- マニュアル{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: according to the manual; by the book
- マニュアル⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: manual transmission car (often abbreviated to マニュアル or MT)
- マニュアル⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: manual labor/operation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧: instruction booklet — the native equivalent; more commonly used for product documentation
- ⟦{手引|てび}き→手引き：12759_tebiki⟧: handbook; guide — a Japanese word with similar meaning, slightly more formal
- ⟦オートマ→オートマ：29984_ootoma⟧: automatic (transmission) — the opposite of マニュアル in the car sense
